search_filters.description: Only tenure_preference, senior_citizen, and interest are valid network search tags.

bap_display_filters.description: Bank name and interest rate sorting are BAP-side display filters applied after on_search.
bap_display_filters.note: Informational — not a network error if applied on BAP only.

select_tenure.description: Tenure is not re-sent in select — it comes from the on_search product.

investor_eligibility_v1.description: init must send INVESTOR_TYPE=INDIVIDUAL_RESIDENT. Reject joint, NRI, minor, HUF, corporate at BAP.

init_bank_or_upi.description: bank_account_number + ifsc OR upi_handle — one pair must be present.

init_nominee.description: Nominee details OR no_nominee_declaration=true required per RBI Nov 2025.

nbfc_credit_rating.description: on_search must include credit_rating_agency and credit_rating when issuer_type is NBFC-D.

on_search_penalty_rate.description: penalty_rate required when premature_withdrawal_allowed is true on on_search.

minimum_deposit.description: deposit_amount must meet minimum_deposit_amount from on_search.

etb_ntb_branch.description: on_init: ETB skips kyc_url; NTB requires kyc_url. KYC must complete before payment.

confirm_amount.description: confirm amount must match deposit_amount from select.

confirm_payment_mode.description: Payment mode is selected at confirm, not earlier in the journey.

on_confirm_required.description: BPP must respond with on_confirm containing all 10 mandatory FD receipt attributes.

vkyc_sla_refund.description: If vkyc_sequence is AFTER_PAYMENT and VKYC not completed within vkyc_sla_hours, refund to source account.

cancel_partial_amount.description: withdrawal_amount required when withdrawal_type is PARTIAL.

premature_withdrawal.description: Product must allow premature/partial withdrawal for the requested operation.

support_form_121_fy.description: financial_year required when service_type is FORM_121.

support_nominee_update.description: Nominee name, relationship, and DOB required when service_type is NOMINEE_UPDATE.

support_maturity_update.description: maturity_instruction required when service_type is MATURITY_INSTRUCTION_UPDATE.

support_service_type.description: support uses SERVICE_TYPE enum for documents, nominee, maturity, portfolio, closure.

fd_reference_valid.description: fd_reference_number must exist and belong to the investor for status, cancel, support.

product_active.description: Selected FD offer must still be active; refresh catalog if stale.

data_mismatch.description: Data in current call must match earlier calls in the same transaction_id.

date_format.description: DD-MM-YYYY for business dates unless ISO timestamp in Beckn time fields.

igm_grievance.description: All grievances via issue/on_issue tracked through ONDC IGM until resolution.

payment_failed.description: Payment to issuer designated account failed or was reversed.
